name: user-scanner-db4ff7e8-blind20-ots
instr:
# OSINT handle-lookup CLI: twenty misbehaviours to diagnose without a test suite

This is a command-line tool that takes a handle or an email address, asks a long list of sites whether it is in use there, and prints what it learns. Nothing about those sites changed and nothing about the way I invoke it changed, yet runs that used to end in a readable report now fall over, report the opposite of the truth, or quietly ask nobody anything. The repository has received 20 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I have been able to observe from the outside, in the order I ran into it.

Getting anything onto the screen is the first thing I hit. A run that does turn something up dies when it tries to turn a hit into a line of terminal text: a type error comes back instead of the text, and an entry that was skipped does the same, so nothing reaches the screen at all. Writing those very same hits out as comma-separated values raises a type error too, while the JSON export of identical data is untouched. And the small state marker at the head of each line no longer follows the state it stands for — hits, misses, errors and skipped entries do not each get their own marker any more — though the colour picked for each of those four states is still right.
